authority_rule.mechanism: Every record at AUTHORITY_BOUND and beyond must carry authority_check.manufactures_authority == false with a non-empty note. A record with manufactures_authority == true fails closed with AUTHORITY_CLAIM_REJECTED. If the authority context is absent, the record must declare fallback_mode == "READ_ONLY"; a FULL fallback with no authority context fails closed. Authority questions route to the LAW domain, never through the handoff pipeline.
authority_rule.statement: A successor package never manufactures authority.

fail_closed_law: Any record violating any gate above makes the handoff file INVALID. UNKNOWN ≠ PASS: a missing section, missing evidence, or missing proof marking is a failure, never an assumption. A section that is neither present nor explicitly named as a gap is treated as a fabrication risk and rejected. Implemented packages ≠ verified packages: a full stage history with empty evidence fails every gate it claims. A continuity receipt that FAILs, or that verifies against a different canonical revision than the package's declared basis, can never produce a TRANSFERRED outcome.

gap_rule.mechanism: At COMPLETENESS_CHECK, every required section with empty or missing content must appear in gaps with a non-empty reason. A section with content must not appear in gaps. Gaps are explicit, named, and carried forward — the successor treats gapped sections as UNKNOWN, never as confirmed.
gap_rule.statement: Gaps are named explicitly; nothing is silently dropped or fabricated.

not_claimed: No live handoff execution engine — this is the verification contract, not an executor.

purpose: Machine-checkable handoff-verification lifecycle for the 08-SUCCESSION domain. Defines the canonical successor-package shape, the five-stage verification pipeline ASSEMBLE → COMPLETENESS_CHECK → AUTHORITY_BOUND → CONTINUITY_VERIFY → TRANSFER, per-stage evidence gates, the successor-package completeness gate, the continuity-verification receipt, the read-only fallback when authority context is missing, and stale-package rejection. A package that cannot be verified is not transferred; a gap that is not named is not a gap, it is a fabrication risk.

read_only_rule.mechanism: fallback_mode == "READ_ONLY" requires an empty authority_context section; fallback_mode == "FULL" requires a non-empty authority_context section. A READ_ONLY transfer may only reach the terminal outcome TRANSFERRED_READ_ONLY. In read-only mode the successor may continue understanding; it may not act, commit, dispatch, or change state.
read_only_rule.statement: Missing authority context degrades the handoff to read-only, never to assumed authority.

scope: Successor-package shape and the five-stage verification pipeline
Per-stage evidence gates (what must be present before a record may sit at a stage)
Read-only fallback when authority context is missing
Stale-package rejection (receipt basis must equal the package's declared basis)

ASSEMBLE.rule: source_manifest must map all 11 package sections to non-empty source strings naming the canonical source each section was drawn from. self_describing must be true: the package carries its schema id, section map, and discovery pointer. package_basis_sha must be a 40-hex SHA.

AUTHORITY_BOUND.rule: authority_check.manufactures_authority must be false with a non-empty note: a successor package never manufactures authority. fallback_mode must be FULL or READ_ONLY. FULL requires a non-empty authority_context section; READ_ONLY requires an empty authority_context section. Missing authority context without a READ_ONLY declaration fails closed.

COMPLETENESS_CHECK.rule: Every section with empty or missing content must appear in gaps with a non-empty reason; a section with content must not appear in gaps. intelligence_items must be a non-empty list; each item names its proof_state: VERIFIED requires a non-empty verification_ref; UNVERIFIED is explicit and honest. Intelligence without proof records is UNVERIFIED, never silently VERIFIED.

CONTINUITY_VERIFY.rule: verification_receipt must carry a 40-hex verified_against_sha, a non-empty checks list, a result of PASS or FAIL, and a non-empty verifier. verified_against_sha must equal package_basis_sha: a receipt that verifies against a different canonical revision makes the package STALE. A FAIL result is recorded honestly — it can never produce a TRANSFERRED outcome.

TRANSFER.rule: transfer_decision.outcome must equal the record outcome and be one of the terminal outcomes. TRANSFERRED requires a PASS receipt and FULL fallback. TRANSFERRED_READ_ONLY requires a PASS receipt and READ_ONLY fallback. STALE requires a non-empty staleness_note naming the newer canonical head. REJECTED requires a non-empty rejection_reason (halt; alert the human director).

stale_rule.mechanism: A package whose verification receipt verifies against a different canonical revision than package_basis_sha is STALE: the record must take the terminal outcome STALE with a non-empty staleness_note naming the newer head. A STALE package is never transferred; it is reassembled from canonical sources.
stale_rule.statement: Stale packages are rejected as stale, never transferred.

transition_law.note: A record at stage N must carry stage_history == stages[0..N] exactly. A record at a non-TRANSFER stage must carry outcome ACTIVE; a TRANSFER-stage record must carry a terminal outcome. Terminal outcomes freeze the stage history.
